review_notes: I read all of the target file. It has three noncomputable kernel definitions (weightedKernel, normalizedKernel, diagonalReplacementKernel) and no theorems or simp attributes. I then checked the companion file Analysis/FiniteKernelMixture.lean and the downstream uses. That companion file states @[simp] weightedKernel_apply and @[simp] normalizedKernel_apply, both proved by rfl. It also has a non-simp diagonalReplacementKernel_apply. The simp lemmas exist but sit in a separate file that imports the Model file. The only Model-side user of normalizedKernel, Model/CircleDigitCoupling.lean, just uses the definition. I found no use of diagonalReplacementKernel_apply by simp or rw. The downstream uses of diagonalReplacementKernel go through the isMarkov, disintegration and event_lower lemmas. I saw no competing rules, rewrite cycles or wrong-direction rewrites. Moving the _apply lemmas next to the definitions is a possible organisational change, but I found no concrete simp failure that it would fix. Adding @[simp] to diagonalReplacementKernel_apply would expand it into a sum of Dirac and ν terms, and I found no use that would benefit. I did not run Lean.
